scope: Metadata candidates only. No new downloads, training-ready release, model selection or inference on Test.
support_policy_note: Planning floor matching the old 75-image class support and W1 group minima; not a statistical power guarantee. Do not relax to reach an accuracy target.
release_gate: New images require download/decode, dimensions, byte/RGB hashes, cross-split duplicate audit and label/box review before a separate training release. Holdout also requires support and exposure review.
